title: Shift zone contents inward
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $z$ consist of a home cell containing an optional Boolean value, left and right lists of optional Boolean values indexed by $0,\ldots,\ell-1$, with each list at index $i$ having length at most $2\cdot 2^i$. Given a side and a natural number $i$, leave the home cell unchanged and shift the lists inward at index $i$ on the side opposite the indicated side; leave the indicated side’s lists unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A zone contents record with a home cell and left and right lists indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$
